_note: Approximate rectangular boxes around hazard-prone landscapes, defined by geography (basins, mountain belts, forest belts), not national borders. bbox = [latMin, latMax, lonMin, lonMax].

zones.name: Whole study area
zones.description: All land in the South Asia study box (5-38N, 60-100E).

zones.name: Ganges-Brahmaputra-Meghna delta
zones.description: Low-lying delta where three of Asia's largest rivers meet the Bay of Bengal. Monsoon rain here and upstream drives river and flash floods.

zones.name: Indus plain
zones.description: Flat, densely farmed floodplain of the Indus. Extreme monsoon rain produced the 2010 and 2022 mega-floods.

zones.name: Central Himalaya
zones.description: Steep, young mountains where saturated monsoon soils trigger thousands of landslides a year.

zones.name: Western Himalaya
zones.description: Mountain belt from Kashmir to Uttarakhand; cloudbursts and road cuts make slopes fail.

zones.name: Western Ghats
zones.description: Coastal mountain range facing the monsoon winds; intense rain caused the 2018 and 2024 Kerala landslide disasters.

zones.name: Sri Lanka central highlands
zones.description: Tea-covered hill country where monsoon downpours regularly trigger landslides.

zones.name: Central Indian forest belt
zones.description: Dry deciduous forests that burn every pre-monsoon season (March-May) when heat peaks and soils dry out.

zones.name: Northeast India and Myanmar hills
zones.description: Forested hills with frequent spring fires; also landslide-prone in the monsoon.
